products.name: Grain
products.note: Meeting recording AI; highlight clips; CRM integration; consent and sharing

profile_text.body:
Grain is an AI meeting recorder and conversation intelligence platform founded in 2018 and headquartered in San Francisco, California. The company describes itself as built for growing teams, with a focus on small to mid-market and enterprise sales, customer success, and product teams. Its platform records video calls, Slack huddles, and in-person meetings, capturing video, desktop audio, transcripts, and notes, then delivers that data to external AI tools such as Claude and ChatGPT so that automated agents can act on it.

The core Grain product provides meeting summaries, account insights, coaching suggestions, CRM integration, highlight clip creation, and consent and sharing controls. It supports transcription in over 130 languages, with the highest accuracy noted for English, Spanish, French, German, Italian, Portuguese, and Japanese, and additional support for Arabic, Hebrew, Thai, and more than 100 other languages. Grain offers a free plan with unlimited recordings subject to a 45-minute meeting limit and 90-day history retention, while paid plans start at $15 per month per user and add advanced AI features, conversational intelligence, unlimited meeting length, and unlimited history. The company states that neither Grain nor its subprocessors use customer data for model training.

The site's held facts note that Grain has a law exposure count of 174 associated with California, though no specific cases are recorded in the available data.
